scope: Phone-only all-frame plane-fit comparison, no map edit, no automatic clearing or navigation
nativeGridDuplicateHandling: Original source stride selects one pixel from each complete 4x4 exported-depth block; no voxel deduplication, no point-centre substitution and no across-frame merging. Distinct views are not statistically independent.
limitations: The +/-12cm candidate band presumes a level-room floor near the supplied plane; this is not general stair or multilevel segmentation.
The1cm RANSAC estimation tolerance is not a clearance threshold. Inliers and residuals, including possible1cm toys, remain raw unresolved evidence.
Plane hull area is estimation support only; it does not fill holes or establish walkable support anywhere.
Plane differences can be depth/pose/export disagreement or actual nonlevel surfaces. No poses or endpoints are shifted.
All raw endpoints/source masks are preserved; this fit output produces no walk mask.
